visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video begins with a close-up of a steaming bowl of tomato tofu and fish soup. The broth is a vibrant red, topped with chopped green onions and cilantro. The bowl is ceramic with a subtle textured rim, placed on a yellow and white striped tablecloth. (2) A transition shows gloved hands preparing raw, pink sea bream fish slices in a white dish. Dark soy paste is drizzled over the fish, followed by clear rice wine and white pepper powder. The hands gently massage the fish to ensure even coating. (3) The cooking sequence moves to a black wok where minced garlic and ginger are sautéed in clear oil until fragrant. Diced tomatoes are then added, releasing their juices as they are stirred with a black and red silicone spatula. (4) Tomato paste is poured into the wok from a small glass bowl, followed by a large amount of water. The mixture is brought to a boil, creating a bubbling red soup base. (5) Cubes of white tofu and the marinated fish slices are carefully slid into the boiling broth. A pinch of salt is added from a small dish. The camera captures the ingredients simmering together as the soup thickens slightly. (6) The video concludes with a final shot of the completed dish served in a light pink ceramic bowl. The steam rises from the hot soup, and the green garnishes provide a fresh color contrast against the rich red broth.
